data.claim: sha256 over class facts only (no hostname, user, path; head excluded) is stable and sensitive to cap changes
data.falsifier: hostname, user or tmp path appearing in key/facts/stamp, or equal keys for different caps
data.mechanism: key hashes a canonical JSON of bucketed facts; probes are injectable so unavailable is a value
data.probe: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_perf_env.py -q
data.question: Can a pure fingerprint give a stable key per machine class, change with the cap, and leak nothing identifying?
